# Sword: a long blade 0.6 m, a wide brass guard, a dark grip and pommel. Grip at the origin, blade up.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Blade --base-color 0.6392 0.6784 0.5451 --no-slot
material new Guard --base-color 0.6392 0.6078 0.4235 --no-slot
material new Grip --base-color 0.1451 0.1647 0.1765 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Grip --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.000
scale 0.070 0.070 0.180
apply --scale
material assign Grip
add mesh cube --name Pommel --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 -0.110
scale 0.100 0.100 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Guard
add mesh cube --name Guard --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.120
scale 0.300 0.090 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Guard
add mesh cube --name Blade --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.440
scale 0.110 0.050 0.580
apply --scale
material assign Blade
active Blade
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.2"
scale 0.3 1 1
mode object
select all
shade flat
export sword.glb
